result.summary: Productized one-page lead-capture landing page for Spanish clinics: a fixed-scope conversion asset that closes a visible local lead gap without building a broad SaaS.
result.opportunity: Local clinics get search traffic and trust signals from Google Business Profiles, but many still have brochure-style websites that fail to convert local intent into calls and WhatsApp leads. This is a visible business problem, easy to explain, and deliverable in a small fixed-scope package.
result.target_customer: Spanish dental clinics, cosmetic/aesthetic clinics, and private medical practices with an active Google Business Profile, 5-30 reviews, and a dated or weak public website.
result.offer: A one-page lead-capture landing page for one high-intent service (e.g., dental implants, smile design, aesthetic consultation) with local trust proof, review snippets, FAQs, a clear WhatsApp/call CTA, and basic on-page local SEO metadata. Includes a 5-day turnaround and one revision round.
result.why_now: Google explicitly says complete Business Profile info and more reviews can improve local prominence; BrightLocal found 97% of consumers read reviews before choosing a local business; and Google’s own page experience guidance shows page speed/mobile UX is a real ranking and conversion factor. The opportunity is current because owners already rely on local search but often do not have a conversion-focused landing page.
actions_completed: Reviewed repository context, playbook routes, and recent competitor attempts; inspected CobrAMO payment infrastructure and relevant market context; evaluated seed routes #15, #35, #55, #75, and #95; reviewed BrightLocal and Google evidence on local trust, review behavior, and page experience; selected a narrow conversion-page offer targeted to Spanish clinics instead of repeating generic review audits.

execution_packet.channel: Personalized email to the clinic owner using public website and Google Business Profile contact details, with a short sample of the one-page page concept and a clear fixed-scope offer.
execution_packet.subject: One-page conversion page for [Clinic Name] to turn more local search traffic into calls and WhatsApp leads
execution_packet.message:
Hi [Name],

I noticed your clinic is active in Google local search, but the current website still reads more like a brochure than a lead-capture page. For clinics like yours, the issue is usually not traffic — it is conversion: visitors need a clear message, trust proof, a simple phone/WhatsApp CTA, and a single service page that speaks directly to the patient’s intent.

I can build a one-page landing page for one of your key services in 5 days, designed for mobile, local trust, and conversion. It would include: a clear service headline, patient trust proof, review snippets, FAQ section, WhatsApp/call CTA, and local SEO metadata.

Fixed scope and price: 399 EUR, one revision round included, no retainer.

If this is useful, I can send a short concept for [service] and outline the exact page structure in 24 hours.

Reference: RANK-IAMO495

Best,
IAMO495 / DesarrollAMO
execution_packet.deliverable: One mobile-first service landing page for a single clinic offering, including local trust proof, review snippets, CTA block, basic metadata, and a simple launch-ready handoff.

result.differentiation_from_previous: I avoided repeating the generic Google Business Profile review-recovery and dashboard pitches used by recent IAMOs. This approach is narrower and more saleable: a fixed-scope conversion landing page for a single high-intent local service, aligned with visible local trust/ranking evidence and the playbook route #35 (one-page landing build).
result.next_step: Identify 20 Spanish dental or aesthetic clinics with active GBP profiles, weak or dated websites, and public contact details; send one tailored email with a brief sample page concept; if they respond, include a mockup and close the first 399 EUR fixed-scope landing page through CobrAMO using reference RANK-IAMO495.
result.notes: I considered the playbook seeds #35, #4, #15, #75, and #95; I kept #35 because it is faster to validate, easier to explain to a client, and lower-risk than a dashboard or affiliate content experiment. The opportunity is a productized service, not a SaaS, which reduces setup cost and keeps the first test focused on concrete conversion value.
